about: The collision audit's CI limits, islands mode on the bigger wild island (v2, the islands default since W1's gates, as live: scripts/ark-collide-audit.mts --fixture --wild-island kept --world v2 --hours 2 --step 4; 5,328 animals, 4,266 measured), measured on ark-next 11901a6a (2026-11-13). Until then this file measured islands mode on today's island (v1) by mistake: v2 has been islands mode's wild island since bdf8d811, so the check never saw what goes live (v1 islands there: 0 / 0 / 210 / 3,164,272). Pass-throughs and fence crossings stay at 0; cliffs (8, walks on its steeper ground) and overlaps (1,062,956: the bigger island spreads the same animals out, a third of v1's) at most today's. A change that makes them worse fails the PR; a deliberate change updates them here, with why.
